# codiva

> codiva® es un estudio senior de software B2B crítico, plataformas de datos e integraciones complejas, con base en Ñuñoa, Santiago de Chile.

## Posicionamiento

codiva construye y moderniza el software que mueve operaciones de negocio. Carlos y Marina trabajan directamente con cada cliente, desde la primera conversación hasta producción, sin equipos rotativos ni traspasos de contexto.

## Servicios

- Construir y evolucionar: productos B2B, plataformas internas y nuevos módulos.
- Modernizar y rescatar: estabilización y evolución incremental de sistemas heredados o difíciles de cambiar.
- Datos e integraciones: pipelines batch o por eventos, enriquecimiento, APIs, interoperabilidad y rendimiento de datos.

## Formas de empezar

- Conversación inicial con los fundadores: 30 minutos, sin costo.
- Diagnóstico de Rescate: dos semanas con riesgos, prioridades, arquitectura y plan de acción.
- Sprint de Producto: una o dos semanas para reducir incertidumbre y producir entregables revisables.
- Construcción y evolución: implementación por incrementos con prioridades visibles, demos y documentación.

## Procedencia de la evidencia

El sitio distingue tres categorías:

- Productos propios de codiva.
- Experiencia profesional previa de los fundadores. Los empleadores anteriores no son clientes de codiva ni implican respaldo.
- Arquitecturas de referencia. Explican patrones que codiva puede diseñar e implementar, sin presentarlos como trabajos de cliente.

No se publican clientes, resultados, métricas, certificaciones, alianzas ni testimonios sin evidencia y autorización.

  - [Ingesta IoT](https://codiva.cl/conocimiento/ingesta-iot/): duplicados, orden, idempotencia, dead-letter, replay y observabilidad.

# codiva — English

> codiva® is a senior engineering studio for business-critical B2B software, data platforms, and complex integrations, based in Ñuñoa, Santiago, Chile.

## Positioning

codiva builds and modernizes the software that runs business operations. Carlos and Marina work directly with each client from the first conversation through production, without rotating teams or context handoffs.

## Services

- Build and evolve: B2B products, internal platforms, and new modules.
- Modernize and rescue: stabilize and incrementally evolve inherited or difficult-to-change systems.
- Data and integrations: batch or event pipelines, enrichment, APIs, interoperability, and data performance.

## Ways to start

- Initial founder conversation: 30 minutes, free of charge.
- Rescue Diagnostic: two weeks covering risks, priorities, architecture, and an action plan.
- Product Sprint: one or two weeks to reduce uncertainty and produce reviewable deliverables.
- Build and evolution: incremental delivery with visible priorities, demos, and documentation.

## Evidence provenance

The site distinguishes three categories:

- Products owned by codiva.
- Prior professional experience of the founders. Former employers are not codiva clients and do not imply endorsement.
- Reference architectures. They explain patterns codiva can design and implement without presenting them as client work.

No clients, outcomes, metrics, certifications, partnerships, or testimonials are published without evidence and authorization.

## English pages

- [Home](https://codiva.cl/en/): positioning, services, and primary evidence.
- [Work](https://codiva.cl/en/projects/): owned products, prior experience, and reference architectures.
  - [Data processing and enrichment pipeline](https://codiva.cl/en/projects/data-pipeline/): prior experience + recoverable architecture.
  - [Clinical interoperability with FHIR](https://codiva.cl/en/projects/fhir-interoperability/): prior experience + reference architecture.
- [Rescue Diagnostic](https://codiva.cl/en/project-rescue/): bounded entry point for existing software.
- [How we work](https://codiva.cl/en/how-we-build/): deliverables, collaboration, risk control, and ownership.
- [Knowledge](https://codiva.cl/en/knowledge/): technical decisions, data, integrations, and interoperability.
  - [Reliable IoT ingestion](https://codiva.cl/en/knowledge/iot-ingestion/): duplicates, ordering, idempotency, dead-letter, replay, and observability.
  - [Nominatim and geocoding](https://codiva.cl/en/knowledge/nominatim-geocoding/): stateless application layer with persistent PostgreSQL/PostGIS.
  - [Integrations and PostgreSQL](https://codiva.cl/en/knowledge/integrations-postgresql/): REST, SOAP, partitioning, indexes, query plans, bloat, and autovacuum.
- [Contact](https://codiva.cl/en/contact/): calendar, WhatsApp, and email.
- [Registered trademark](https://codiva.cl/en/trademark/): legal INAPI registration information.
